projects.title: Tableware for Naver training center
projects.desc: Every corporate dining space looks the same. This one doesn't. Reinterpreting Joseon Baekja through Naver's 'Connect One' identity — eight vessel forms that feel traditional and entirely contemporary at once.

projects.title: Tea ware collection
projects.desc: The brief was to make tea approachable. The result was a set that doesn't ask you to understand ceramics — it asks you to sit down. Balanced form from every angle, at every price point.

projects.title: Bird & Cloud souvenir collection
projects.desc: A souvenir is a memory in object form. Sold exclusively at MoMA Store New York under a five-year contract — the Bird & Cloud became the shape people chose to remember Seoul by.

projects.title: Candle & diffuser brand direction
projects.desc: From naming rationale to vessel geometry to shelf presence — full creative direction for a fragrance brand now placed in Hilton and Hyatt properties.

projects.title: TR Cream limited edition vessel
projects.desc: When a skincare brand asks for something that feels like morning dew on a tea leaf, the answer is never obvious. Porcelain as metaphor, executed precisely.

projects.title: GICB international competition trophy
projects.desc: The official trophy of the world's largest ceramic competition. The form borrowed its language from kiln furniture — the unglamorous post that holds everything upright at extreme heat.
